classification.difficultyReason: Combine triangular and semicircular end areas with exposed flat and curved lateral surfaces, excluding the internal join.

content.prompt: Find the surface area of this composite prism to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Right-triangular prism joined to a semicylinder along the triangle’s hypotenuse. Includes the right-angle mark, leader identifying the shared 5 cm diameter, 9 cm extrusion and dashed construction lines.
spec.mathematics: Triangle legs 3 cm and 4 cm; shared hypotenuse and semicircle diameter 5 cm; radius 2.5 cm; prism length 9 cm. The shared rectangular joining surface is internal.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
r&=\frac52=2.5\,\mathrm{cm}\\
\text{Front and back}&=2\left(\frac{4\times3}{2}+\frac{\pi(2.5)^2}{2}\right)=12+6.25\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\
\text{Left rectangle}&=4\times9=36\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\
\text{Bottom rectangle}&=3\times9=27\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\
\text{Curved surface}&=\frac12\times2\pi(2.5)(9)=22.5\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\
\text{Total surface area}&=12+6.25\pi+36+27+22.5\pi\\
&=75+28.75\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\
&\approx165.32\,\mathrm{cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
The shared rectangular join is inside the solid, so it is excluded.
